statement: S3 equivalence over an algebraically closed field of characteristic other than two on a nonsingular short Weierstrass curve, including repeated x, holds in the actual Mathlib elliptic point group.
For the specified F2[x0,x1] fixture, no Groebner basis lies in the degree2 generator span, and a Groebner basis lies in the explicit degree-at-most-three row span.
